summary: Get rid of all 36 Glass Panes, put 40 Veggies in a Market and finish by day 35 for the optional. A Canteen Factory turns 2 Glass, 1 Reed and some Sticks into a Canteen: about 18 Reed and 8 Sticks clear the stash. Pumpkins (4-day crop) fill the Market fastest.

build_order.note: 15 Planks to the build site already on the map.
16 Bricks + 6 Planks; up to 10 Canteens a day with two workers.

pitfalls: Only seven villagers: build in objective order and staff sparingly.
Two finished-looking towers are Fake Watch Towers and do not count; deliver 15 Planks to the real Watchtower build site.
Every pane must go, including any carried into warehouses.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
